title.langstring: Spotting a Phishing Email: Practical Skills for Everyone

description.langstring: Could you spot a phishing email before you click? Every day, seemingly ordinary emails can put your personal and company information at risk. This concise, interactive course will show you exactly what to look for, how to react if something seems suspicious, and what steps to take if you make a mistake. By the end, you’ll have the confidence and practical skills to identify and respond to phishing attempts—protecting yourself and your workplace from real threats.

title.langstring: How to Spot and Respond to Phishing Emails

description.langstring: Test your ability to spot phishing emails by looking for red flags like generic greetings such as “Dear User” and suspicious messages from IT asking you to confirm your password. Find out what to do if you click a bad link, including why disconnecting from the internet right away can help prevent bigger disruptions.
